recordedBy: claude-code-session, transcribing an exact owner decision
whatThisRecordIs: An IMMUTABLE governance record of the owner's operational adjudication of the one SD7 implementation edge case the A3a pilot returned for confirmation. It adds a decision; it changes no evidence, no frozen methodology byte and no earlier record. The A3a execution record named below is NOT edited, NOT re-hashed and NOT re-statused - this file references it by SHA-256, which is the only correction mechanism this methodology has.

theReturnedTokenThisAnswers.theQuestionAsPosed: One analysed document fell below the 5-gram shingle window, so it produced an EMPTY shingle set. Jaccard(empty, empty) is undefined, and the pilot refused to invent a value for it rather than silently calling the document a near-duplicate or silently calling it unique.

ownerDecision.sd9FinalisationRule: finalise only if every admissible treatment lies on the same side of the MIN_PAGES_PER_ORGANISATION = 4 boundary

clauses: do NOT silently declare them near-duplicates or unique
if all possible treatments leave the organisation on the SAME side of the >=4-page SD9 boundary, SD9 may be mechanically finalised
if the unresolved short-text treatment COULD move the organisation across the >=4 boundary, status remains ACQUISITION_STATUS_PENDING_SD7_OWNER_DETAIL and execution stops for owner review
frozenOperationalRuleGoingForward.whyThisIsNotAMethodologyChange: SD7 already refuses to invent a similarity value for an empty shingle set, and SD9 already decides on a page count against MIN_PAGES_PER_ORGANISATION = 4. This rule says only WHEN an unresolved SD7 detail is permitted to stop being decision-relevant: when it is provably unable to change the SD9 answer under ANY admissible treatment. It adds no similarity value, moves no threshold and removes no flag.
frozenOperationalRuleGoingForward.theSemanticQuestionIsDeferredNotAnswered: A short-text document's near-duplicate status remains genuinely unresolved. This rule governs whether that unresolved status BLOCKS, never what the resolution is.
frozenOperationalRuleGoingForward.decisionRelevanceIsProvedNotAssumed: The implementation must evaluate the SD9 outcome across EVERY admissible treatment of the unresolved document and finalise only when the whole range falls on one side of the boundary. A single treatment that crosses the boundary is enough to block.

whatThisDoesNotChange.statement: Every value in this object is false in the sense of 'this decision changed it'. NEAR_DUPLICATE_SHINGLE_SIZE remains 5, NEAR_DUPLICATE_JACCARD_THRESHOLD remains 0.9 compared at-or-above inclusive, MIN_PAGES_PER_ORGANISATION remains 4, comparison scope remains WITHIN_ONE_ORGANISATION_ONLY, and the R3 bytes named above are untouched.

howThisAppliesToTheBatch01Result.whyTheFinalisationWasAlreadyAdmissible: The A3a pilot measured the exact RANGE of post-SD7 page counts over all possible survivor orders per organisation and finalised only where the whole range fell on one side of MIN_PAGES_PER_ORGANISATION. The one short-text document could not move its organisation across that boundary under any treatment, which is exactly the condition this rule now names.

whatThisRecordDoesNotDo: it does not resolve the semantic near-duplicate status of any short-text document
it does not authorise Batch 02 - that is a separate owner decision in a separate record
it does not authorise any reserve consumption or replacement
it does not change any frozen methodology rule, including the 5-gram size, the Jaccard threshold, P5's threshold or SD9's minimum
it does not grant any network, labelling, provider-inference or HOLDOUT authority
it does not declare any organisation ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL or ACQUISITION_UNSUCCESSFUL beyond what A3a already mechanically finalised
